summary: Phase 2 User-Wise Pricing Engine + storefront YOUR PRICE tested end-to-end. Backend: 21/21 pytest passed covering guest public pricing (product detail/list/cart all source='public', no your_price, no category_prices matrix leak), category pricing CRUD (GET matrix, PUT sets/updates, blank clears), doctor sees category rate 130 (source='category', is_special=true), customer-specific override sets 120 + 10+3 offer (source='manual', offer_source='customer', free_qty=3), toggle protected works, DELETE resets to category, price history endpoint, order/cart lines include price_source+offer_source, master switch enable_customer_pricing=false forces public for everyone, enable_customer_specific_pricing=false falls back to category, pending customer gets public pricing (no your_price). Settings restored to True and doctor left with 120 + 10+3 offer as required. SECURITY verified: storefront never leaks category_prices matrix. Frontend UI: ProductDetail correctly shows YOUR SPECIAL PRICE ₹120 with 10+3 offer for logged-in doctor, and 'Login to view your special price' button for guests. Products listing ProductCard shows ₹120 YOUR PRICE + 10+3 badge (initially rendered stale bundle - fixed by frontend restart). AdminPricingManager routes at /admin/pricing-manager with tab-category-pricing + tab-customer-pricing, cat-product-picker+search, cat-input-<variant>-<category> matrix (doctor 100ml showed 130 loaded correctly), and cust-picker on customer tab. No critical bugs found.

issues: No 'Pricing Manager' link in admin sidebar navigation (Store section) despite route existing at /admin/pricing-manager — admins have to know the URL. Add a sidebar entry.

action_items: (Optional) Add 'Pricing Manager' link under Store or Customer sidebar section pointing to /admin/pricing-manager for discoverability
critical_code_review_comments: pricing_engine.pick_offer_schemes: correctly enforces category>public with no stacking. Consider adding time-window (start_date/end_date) filter here too — currently applicable_schemes handles it but worth verifying.

catalog.enrich_products: only exposes your_price/price_source/is_special when source != 'public'. This is the correct security guard preventing leak. Confirmed via test that category_prices matrix never appears in storefront responses.
pricing.upsert_customer_price: no validation that supplied 'offer' dict has valid scheme_type/buy_quantity/etc — a malformed offer would still be stored. Consider Pydantic model for offer body.
pricing.set_product_pricing: accepts float(rate) but no lower bound; a negative rate would be persisted. Add rate >= 0 guard.
orders.resolve_cart: correctly re-prices server-side using price_line for each cart item — never trusts frontend price. Good.

During testing the /products listing initially showed stale bundle (ProductCard without your_price code) despite source having it. A frontend supervisor restart fixed it. Suggest verifying HMR is picking up component changes reliably during deploy.

rca_of_the_issue: No production bugs. One transient testing issue: the deployed frontend bundle initially did not include the ProductCard your_price rendering despite the source containing it — resolved by 'sudo supervisorctl restart frontend'.
